title: Korean 1
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
You cannot enrol in this course if you are a native speaker of Korean.
Students with previous experience of the language must sit a language proficiency assessment.

title: Korean 2
college: ANU College of Asia and the Pacific
requisiteText:
To enrol in this course you must have completed KORE1020, undertake a language proficiency assessment or be given permission by the course convener.

Incompatible with KORE6121.
